content:
#3 I don’t know how to interpret what I see in the logs, but it could possibly be a misconfiguration of the proxy that is presumably in place at Oberwolfach which you are avoiding by going through a new proxy. There’s certainly a load of weird stuff in the logs, but the IPs don’t resolve to anything so I can’t trace them definitely to Oberwolfach.

I’m reluctant to accuse Oberwolfach of not being correctly configured! I’d presume that they’d know what they are doing, which is more than I do. Can you see the rforum (without the new proxy)?
